A consequence of that is that white male opinions are simply not the overwhelming majority of what's heard online any longer. And I think that because white male opinions are now just one of many (as opposed to other media where they're the majority) many white males feel that their views are now the ones that are getting marginalized. I think this makes many white males angry, because they aren't used to being ignored or dismissed. Just my opinion.
